def factor_volume_price_corr_logret_logvol(df):
    """Rolling correlation between log price changes and log-volume changes."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    log_close = np.log(df_copy["close"])
    ret = log_close.diff()
    vol_chg = np.log1p(df_copy["volume"]).pct_change()
    corr = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=5).corr(vol_chg)
    corr = corr.fillna(0.0)
    corr.name = "factor_volume_price_corr_logret_logvol"
    return corr
description: Preserves parent's core rolling price-volume correlation mechanism and RankICIR/RankIC stability. Bottleneck: low MI partially driven by raw price percentage-change outliers and asymmetry. Mutation replaces close.pct_change with log return (diff of log close), reducing right-tail price spike distortion while keeping direction and zero-lag. Volume side remains parent's bounded log1p pct_change. This single targeted logarithmic adjustment should improve nonlinear price-volume dependence without adding components or cross-sectional transform.
